checkEmail.noEmail: No email? Check your spam folder, or ask for a new link.

confirmEmail.resent: We sent a new link to {{email}}.
confirmEmail.failedBody: It may be old. Log in with your email and password to ask for a new link.

acceptInvite.title: Set up your staff account
acceptInvite.intro: You were invited to join the staff. Give your name and choose a password.
acceptInvite.doneBody: Log in with the email the invite was sent to and the password you chose.
acceptInvite.missingBody: Check that you used the whole link from the email.
acceptInvite.invite-used: This invite has already been used. Log in with the email and password you chose.
acceptInvite.invite-expired: This invite has expired. Ask an admin or a manager to send a new one.
acceptInvite.invalid-invite: This invite link doesn't work. Check that you used the whole link from the email.
acceptInvite.account-exists: An account with this email already exists. Log in to it, then open the link from the email again.
acceptInvite.existingTitle: Add the staff role to your account
acceptInvite.existingIntro: You were invited to join the staff with the account you already have. Log in to that account, then accept here. Your membership stays as it is.
acceptInvite.existingDone: Your account now has the staff role
acceptInvite.existingDoneBody: Staff pages need the authenticator app. You'll be asked to set it up.
acceptInvite.notLoggedIn: Log in to the account the invite was sent to, then open the link from the email again.
acceptInvite.invite-for-another-account: This invite is for another email. Log in with the account the invite was sent to.

checkIn.paymentMissingHelp: Your membership payment hasn't arrived, so you can't check in. Ask the staff for help.

checkIn.failed: The reader didn't answer. Try again.

payments.awaitingFirst: No payment yet. Your membership starts with the first payment.

simulatedPayments.title: Simulated payments
simulatedPayments.periodFrom: Or pay one month starting on
simulatedPayments.periodHint: Choose a past date to try a missing payment. Later payments must start the day after the paid-until date.
simulatedPayments.skip: To skip a payment, just don't send one.

cancellation.notice: You have one month's notice to the end of a month. Your access lasts until the cancellation takes effect.

cancellation.undoKeepsBookingsCancelled: Undoing does not restore class bookings that were cancelled. You can book them again.

loginCode.intro: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code it shows for FitnessCenter.
loginCode.recoveryIntro: Type one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up the app. Each code works once.
loginCode.failed: That code didn't work. Try the newest code, or log in again.

authenticator.title: Authenticator app
authenticator.required: Staff accounts need an authenticator app before they can use staff pages.
authenticator.stepApp: Open an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
authenticator.stepScan: Scan this QR code with the app.
authenticator.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
authenticator.keyIntro: Can't scan it? Add the account by hand with this setup key:
authenticator.stepCode: Type the 6-digit code the app now shows.
authenticator.wrongCode: That code doesn't match. Check that your phone's clock is right and type the code the app shows now.
authenticator.done: The authenticator app is on. From now on you'll enter a code from it when you log in.
authenticator.recoveryIntro: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe, such as your password manager. Each one logs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
authenticator.alreadyOn: The authenticator app is already on for your account.

states.errorTitle: This page could not be loaded
states.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.

staffInvite.title: Invite staff
staffInvite.intro: We email the person a link. It works once, for 7 days. They choose their name and password, or log in if they already have an account.

roleHints.Admin: Everything, including inviting managers and admins.
roleHints.Manager: Runs the center day to day and invites front desk and instructors.
roleHints.Instructor: Teaches classes and sees only their own.

staffInvite.languageHint: Used when the email has no account yet. An existing account gets the email in its own language.
staffInvite.sent: Invite sent to {{email}} as {{role}}. The link works until {{expires}}.
staffInvite.notAllowed: Only admins and managers can invite staff.

errors.role-not-allowed: You may not give this role. A manager can invite front desk and instructors only.
errors.already-has-role: This account already has this role.
